tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: App and page background. Text on it uses text-primary and text-secondary.

tokens.name: bg-welcome
tokens.usage: Mel welcome shell and decorative bubble-field base.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Default card. Filled, no border. Text on it uses text-primary and text-secondary.

tokens.name: surface-card-bordered
tokens.usage: Bordered card variant. Pair with border-card.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and the dock pill.

tokens.name: surface-input
tokens.usage: Search capsule, segmented track and inputs.

tokens.name: surface-tile
tokens.usage: Icon tiles and tinted fills inside cards.

tokens.name: surface-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheet and modal background.

tokens.name: surface-sheet-card
tokens.usage: Card sitting on a sheet.

tokens.name: border-card
tokens.usage: Outline of the bordered and outline card variants.

tokens.name: border-glass
tokens.usage: Hairline on glass surfaces (headers, footers, glass buttons).

tokens.name: separator-on-card
tokens.usage: Line between rows inside a card.

tokens.name: separator-on-raised
tokens.usage: Line between rows in menus and popovers.

tokens.name: separator-on-page
tokens.usage: Line between rows directly on the page.

tokens.name: separator-on-sheet
tokens.usage: Line between rows on a sheet.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Main text on bg-page, surface-card, surface-raised and surface-sheet.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg-page and surface-card.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and hints on bg-page and surface-card.

tokens.name: text-gold
tokens.usage: Compatibility name for the MEL link and money-emphasis text color; resolves to Green Text on light.

tokens.name: text-mel
tokens.usage: Text that speaks as Mel, on bg-page and surface-card.

tokens.name: text-on-action
tokens.usage: Label on action-primary and action-voice. Deep Teal; white is never used on Mel Green.

tokens.name: text-on-destructive
tokens.usage: Label on action-destructive.

tokens.name: text-on-voice
tokens.usage: Label on action-voice.

tokens.name: switch-thumb
tokens.usage: Thumb of rm-switch. White in both themes, like the platform switches. Not a label colour.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Links and accent text on bg-page and surface-card.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Primary action fill. Light: Deep Teal with a white label. Dark: Mint with a Deep Teal label.

tokens.name: action-glass
tokens.usage: Glass button fill (back, close, header actions).

tokens.name: action-destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive action text and icon. Dark uses a soft red for contrast; label on a filled badge uses text-on-destructive.

tokens.name: action-voice
tokens.usage: Voice and accent action fill. Label uses text-on-voice.

tokens.name: action-voice-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of action-voice.

tokens.name: action-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of action-primary.

tokens.name: action-primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of action-primary.

tokens.name: tint-gold-bg
tokens.usage: Compatibility name for the MEL tinted background behind money or emphasis.

tokens.name: tint-mel-bg
tokens.usage: Tinted background for Mel suggestion cards.

tokens.name: status-success-bg
tokens.usage: Success chip or banner fill. Pair with status-success-fg.

tokens.name: status-success-fg
tokens.usage: Success text and icon on status-success-bg.

tokens.name: status-info-bg
tokens.usage: Info chip or banner fill. Pair with status-info-fg.

tokens.name: status-info-fg
tokens.usage: Info text and icon on status-info-bg.

tokens.name: status-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning chip or banner fill. Pair with status-warning-fg.

tokens.name: status-warning-fg
tokens.usage: Warning text and icon on status-warning-bg.

tokens.name: status-danger-bg
tokens.usage: Danger chip or banner fill. Pair with status-danger-fg.

tokens.name: status-danger-fg
tokens.usage: Danger text and icon on status-danger-bg.

tokens.name: icon-reach
tokens.usage: Icon-only category colour for c-prompt-card (Reach out). Never for text, fills or status.

tokens.name: icon-clients

tokens.name: icon-plan

tokens.name: icon-insight

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline on every control, with a page-color gap.

tokens.name: focus-ring-voice
